asyncio¶

asyncio is a library to write concurrent code using the async/await syntax. It is used as a foundation for multiple Python asynchronous frameworks.

The library provides high-level APIs to run coroutines concurrently and control their execution, plus low-level APIs for library authors.

Note
Prefer the high-level API unless you are writing a framework.
async def main():
    await asyncio.sleep(1)
